The sum of all integers from 1 to 1000 that are divisible by both 3 and 7 is **23,688**. 

These numbers are multiples of 21 (the least common multiple of 3 and 7). The sequence starts at 21 and ends at 987 (the largest multiple of 21 ≤ 1000), with 47 terms in total. Using the arithmetic series formula:
